meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成编写可安全寻址的关键帧:推进拉远、缩放、重新构图、Ken Burns 运镜、遮罩与 SVG 变形等,并用 hyperframes keyframes 等命令做验证。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推进拉远、缩放重构图或运镜等可安全寻址的 2D/3D 关键帧时,或要写 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等动画时接管;不负责整体分镜、品牌设计与字幕。

say.text: 给这个 HyperFrames 片段加一个推进再拉远的景别变化
say.note: 会写入关键帧并做关键帧诊断

say.text: 做一个沿路径移动的物体动画,并保持同一物体身份连续
say.note: 会建可寻址的路径补间,只动一个主体

say.text: 跑一下 hyperframes keyframes 诊断,看看遮罩重构图对不对
say.note: 会输出关键帧诊断与快照

howto.what_en: Claude writes seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames compositions: punch-in/out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns, camera moves, masks, SVG morph and draw, 3D depth. Then it verifies with hyperframes lint, check and keyframes.
howto.when_en: When a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes (punch-in/out, zoom, reframe, camera moves) or GSAP, CSS, Anime.js animation. Not for scene strategy, brand design or captions.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in then punch-out to this HyperFrames clip.
say_en.note: Writes keyframes, then runs keyframe diagnostics.

say_en.text: Animate an object moving along a path, keeping its identity.
say_en.note: Builds a seek-safe path tween with one subject.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes diagnostics on the mask reframe.
say_en.note: Returns keyframe diagnostics and a shot.
